title: High-frequency digital collection of patient-reported outcomes in patients with smoldering multiple myeloma
summary: Smoldering multiple myeloma is a precursor stage of multiple myeloma in which affected individuals are currently monitored closely, usually without drug therapy. Although this phase is often classified as asymptomatic, many patients nevertheless report noticeable burdens in their daily lives. Through our study, we aim to investigate how frequently such symptoms actually occur and how they impact quality of life. To this end, we collect brief digital questionnaires at regular intervals over the course of one year.

interventions.name: Patients with smoldering multiple myeloma are surveyed every 14 days over the course of one year regarding their quality of life and symptoms.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Confirmed diagnosis of smoldering multiple myeloma
Participation in the Heidelberg University Hospital Myeloma Registry
Exclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of amyloidosis or MGCS
Lack of capacity to consent
